# Requirements Quality Checklist: Diagnostics and Release

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of feature 006 (FR-18, FR-20, FR-28 uninstaller part, NFR-07 crash records, NFR-09, NFR-12, the "deployed" pipeline and release publishing) — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability and coverage of the spec before planning
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard · Audience: reviewer (spec/plan review) · Focus: privacy of logs and crash files, crash-detection correctness, uninstall data lifecycle, release pipeline failure branches. Items marked `[x]` were resolved by the generating agent by improving the spec in the same session (as the caller instructed); each says how. The owner/reviewer may re-open any of them.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the rotation trigger of the active log file specified, so that a single burst cannot exceed the 10 MB total? [Gap, Spec §FR-008] — resolved: roll at 2 MB or at local date change.
- [x] CHK002 Is "crash record" defined as a concrete artefact (a crash file vs only a log line)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013, req FR-20] — resolved: a crash file of kind "abnormal end", plus a log line.
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for a session ended by the installer/uninstaller so it is not counted as a crash? [Gap, Spec §FR-013(b), US4-AS6] — yes.
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for OS logoff/shutdown, so routine shutdowns do not produce crash records? [Gap, Spec §FR-013, Edge Cases] — yes.
- [x] CHK005 Is the second-instance case defined for the marker, rotation and crash retention? [Gap, Edge Cases] — yes: only the primary instance touches them.
- [x] CHK006 Is the effect of an unwritable log directory on the session marker and crash files stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-009] — resolved: stated in FR-009.
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for the upgrade path (installer over an existing install) regarding user data? [Gap, Spec §FR-024, US4-AS7] — yes.
- [x] CHK008 Is the autostart entry's fate on uninstall specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-023] — yes: always removed.
- [x] CHK009 Is the content of the release (assets, checksum, notes) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029, FR-030] — yes.
- [x] CHK010 Is the "measured installed size" defined (what is counted, when)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019] — resolved: files written by the installer, measured before first launch.
- [x] CHK011 Is how the user views third-party licenses specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-033] — resolved: opens the installed notices file in the default viewer; failure message defined.
- [ ] CHK012 Is the full approved-license list (SPDX identifiers) stated as a requirement, or left to the plan? [Completeness, Spec §FR-031] — open: the spec states the rule (permissive yes, GPL/LGPL/AGPL no); the concrete list (incl. MPL-2.0 and Unicode licenses) is a plan decision (research.md) that the owner should confirm.
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements stated for what users see when the app restarts after a crash (any notice)? [Gap, Assumptions] — open: the spec assumes no user notice in release 1 (log line only); the requirements are silent. Owner to confirm.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK014 Is the start line's exact text pinned, since CI greps for it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003] — yes: `voicen <version> (<commit>) started`.
- [x] CHK015 Is the representation of a timing that did not occur specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005] — yes: absent, not 0.
- [x] CHK016 Is "once" in "one-time notification" defined (per session vs ever)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009] — resolved by Clarification Q3 (confirmed by the owner 2026-10-02).
- [x] CHK017 Is the allowed crash-file content an allowlist rather than a denylist? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014] — yes (Clarification Q2, confirmed by the owner 2026-10-02).
- [x] CHK018 Is the log-line content an allowlist of typed fields, with library output excluded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, P-009] — yes.
- [x] CHK019 Is the timestamp format (local vs UTC) defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] — yes: local time with UTC offset.
- [x] CHK020 Is concurrency safety of log writing stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-004] — resolved: whole lines, never interleaved.
- [x] CHK021 Is the silent-uninstall behaviour defined? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021] — resolved by Clarification Q4 (confirmed by the owner 2026-10-02).

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK022 Does the start-line format agree with the existing CI smoke check (`(<commit>) started`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, ci.yml] — yes.
- [x] CHK023 Are crash files consistently excluded from both the 7-day and the 10 MB log rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, FR-015] — yes.
- [x] CHK024 Does "default yes" on uninstall agree with the silent-uninstall default? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021] — yes.
- [x] CHK025 Does the About format `Voicen <version> (<commit>)` satisfy req FR-18's "`<version> (abc123)`"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002] — yes: contains it.
- [x] CHK026 Is ownership of the tray item, the timings and the key-slot naming consistent with features 001 and 004? [Consistency, Assumptions] — yes: 001 owns the tray and the timing values, 004 the key slots; 006 owns the log seam, actions and uninstaller.
- [ ] CHK027 Is the install folder vs data folder relationship consistent with req FR-28's "all app data lives in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Voicen`" when the program is installed into the same folder? [Consistency, Assumptions, req FR-28] — open: the spec allows the Tauri default (same folder); research.md weighs a separate program folder. Raised as a finding for the owner.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK028 Can "no transcript text, audio or keys in logs" be measured objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — yes: 0 occurrences of planted values.
- [x] CHK029 Can "exactly one crash record per abnormal end" be measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — yes.
- [x] CHK030 Does every req FR-20 acceptance example (dictation line, forced panic, kill, 20-day crash file, unwritable dir) map to a scenario? [Traceability] — yes: US2-AS1, US3-AS1, US3-AS2, US3-AS5, US2-AS6.
- [ ] CHK031 Can SC-009 (clean Windows 11 install + first dictation) be checked by anyone other than the owner? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009] — open by design: requirements §9 assign it to the owner's manual check in Windows Sandbox.
